title: slo.v1
description: A service level objective (00_UniversalStandards/16_Service_Design_Record.md §2): a target for one SLI over a rolling window, with the burn-rate alerts that page or ticket on it (04_OperationalRunbooks/02_Monitoring_Alert_Thresholds.md §2). Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by the design record's relationship rules and covered by vectors: the SLI must exist in the same record; a target must be stricter than any external commitment; and one full outage lasting the service's RTO must fit inside the error budget of the window.

sli.description: The id of an sli.v1 in the same design record.

external_commitment_percent.description: A commitment made to someone outside the team (an SLA), if any. The target must be strictly higher.

burn_rate_alerts.description: Multi-window burn-rate alerts: at least one that pages and one that opens a ticket.

duration.description: A Prometheus range such as 5m, 1h or 6h.
